title: valeriana repens var. calvescens
intro: Valeriana repens var. calvescens, commonly known as creeping valerian, is a type of flowering plant in the family Valerianaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including promoting relaxation and reducing stress, which are attributed to its therapeutic actions such as sedative, anxiolytic, and antispasmodic effects. The bioactive constituents of creeping valerian include valerenic acid, isovalerenic acid, and valepotriates, which are responsible for its health benefits, including improved sleep quality, reduced anxiety and muscle tension, and enhanced mood. Additionally, creeping valerian has been used to treat various health conditions, including insomnia, restlessness, and menstrual cramps, making it a valuable natural remedy for promoting overall well-being.
